answers.ask: Do players claim a pre-built house, or get an empty plot to build their own? That decision changes the whole city grid.
answers.answer: Players claim pre-built detailed 3D houses; the game is focused on a realistic city experience, not house construction.

answers.ask: Are the racing streets timed with laps and a finish line, or just roads that are good to drive fast on?
answers.answer: Use dedicated racing streets with timed laps and a clear finish line so players have an actual race activity.

scene_prompt: Create a detailed 3D open-world city map with a realistic, lived-in street grid. Arrange claimable pre-built detailed houses in residential neighborhoods, with stores and other city buildings along commercial streets. Include broad drivable roads for cars throughout the city and a dedicated racing-street circuit with a visible start/finish line and lap route. Compose dense urban foreground streets leading through housing and shop districts toward a larger city backdrop.
agent_notes: The prompt names Brookhaven outright and the author confirmed players claim pre-built detailed houses rather than construct them, which is settlement-claimable and the Life preset — the genre file warns specifically against reading a Brookhaven prompt as a grid of empty lots. Racing is named second because the author, asked directly, said the racing streets are timed with laps and a clear finish line, which is the exact test the Racing file uses to separate a real race from streets that are merely good to drive fast on; it contributes trigger-lap and trigger-finish as options but does not lead, so its genre-wide P6 does not apply to the whole city. Only one shape can be taken and the sentence is about the city, so the circuit loses the shape contest to the housing model and the racing streets are laid into the road network. The route is P3 for the houses and stores players go inside, plus P6 carried by the finish trigger, because a lap course still has to read as one continuous connected circuit that an image alone cannot guarantee.

notes: dropped option 'trigger-lap': not in Roleplay & Avatar Sim
dropped option 'trigger-finish': not in Roleplay & Avatar Sim
